correctness.rationale: Exact Walsh fourth-moment expansion (1), two four-cycle edge-pair counting identities (2), and elementary decomposition into Kneser eigenspaces 0,1,2 prove the universal nonnegative identity (3). Its two eigenspace coefficients are lambda>2 and 2, proving the quantitative remainder for all real coefficients and n>=6. The unique extremizer sign class follows from all four-cycle sign products positive; the isometry-group-averaging lemma establishes the Banach–Mazur optimum. Standalone exact arithmetic checks for n=6,7,8 verified (1), (3), and direct 2^n-state expectation; finite tests are not substituted for a universal proof.

value.rationale: The real complete second homogeneous Walsh chaos is a canonical dim=binomial(n,2) Banach subspace. Its sharp L4/L2 embedding norm and exact Banach–Mazur distortion are natural geometric invariants, not arbitrary parameter samples. A uniform n>=6 formula, a Kneser-spectrum SOS and unique switching extremizers plus a quantitative magnitude-deficit bound encode nontrivial structure and have potential use for tight finite-dimensional hypercontractivity and stability. The exact 15 limit connects full quadratic Walsh chaos to standardized centered chi-square behavior; no application or downstream theorem beyond the proved statements is asserted.
